svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Annual rate of people requiring immediate assistance due to all
natural disasters excluding extreme temperatures World, 2000 to 2025
Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires,
storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here because their geographical and time coverage is poor,

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
